critical_code_review_comments: boxShadow computed value is 'rgba(0,0,0,0) 0px 0px 0px 0px' (not the literal string 'none'). This is functionally equivalent and renders no shadow, but if a future test asserts strict equality with 'none' it will false-fail. Consider adding boxShadow:'none' as any directly in the boxFramed style so the computed value matches the literal 'none' string and any downstream snapshot/regex checks pass cleanly.
